qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the vacuum pump on cylinder head M6 screws?
What size screws are used for the M51/M41 vacuum pump installation?
What is the torque specification for M8 screws on the M51/M41 vacuum pump?
What is the torque specification for M9 screws on the M51/M41 vacuum pump?
Are the torque specifications the same for M8 and M9 screws on the M51/M41 vacuum pump?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, both M8 and M9 screws require 22 Nm of torque

qa_pairs.question: What component section is covered under reference 11 66?
Which vacuum pump installation is described as microencapsulated?
What is the difference in torque requirements between the 1AZ and M51/M41 vacuum pump installations?
qa_pairs.answer: The 1AZ uses M6 screws torqued to 10 Nm, while the M51/M41 uses M8 and M9 screws torqued to 22 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What engine types use the higher torque specification for vacuum pump mounting?
qa_pairs.answer: M51/M41 engines use the higher torque specification of 22 Nm
